You can not convince me this whole thing was not done with PRECISELY that goal in mind.

For an administration that claimed to be "America First" they have proven to anyone with working brains to be anything but.

People are not angry enough. People are not scared enough.

These are truly perilous times. But people are so damn complacent that they can't be assed to do anything about it.

Thus we march everlong into full on fascism.
